Troubleshooting · 38/50 · capture

Camera report incomplete

Failure signal

A camera report incomplete condition is reported or detected during capture.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for capture does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Check each card and take for lens, filter, rate, color and notes required downstream.

Corrective action

Reconstruct only from source metadata and crew confirmation, marking inferred fields.

Prevention

Add this verification to the capture gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
